thread: Replace with the durable programme thread.
objective: Replace with one durable, verifiable domain outcome.

anchors.description: Exclusive domain ownership and evidence boundary.
Admission, capacity, recovery, and qualification policy.

constraints.text: Do not replace provider process control, routing, messaging, or telemetry.
Fleet admission is eligibility-only; the provider must atomically revalidate capacity and claims while reserving the process slot.
Goal UI state is not task completion or qualification.

actions.text: For writes, acquire an exact active work claim; record eligibility; then require provider-atomic compare-and-start.
Delegate bounded task packets to Luna workers within exclusive write fences.
Route candidate commits and evidence to an independent verifier.
Checkpoint durable state and append callbacks at each material boundary.

verification.check: Fleet and Project OS contracts pass.
Independent receipt binds evidence to the candidate SHA.

return_contract.final_verdict: PASS or FAIL; never infer completion from goal status

stop_conditions: Ownership overlaps another active domain or work claim.
Verifier capacity or an evidence path is unavailable.
Machine thresholds fail or the worktree is dirty.
A restart lacks a durable checkpoint.
